meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Git 专家，帮你把代码改动拆成多个小提交、整理提交历史、查找某行代码是谁写的或何时加入的。
howto.when: 当你提到“提交”、“rebase”、“squash”、“谁写了”、“什么时候加的”、“找到那个提交”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这些改动，拆成多个原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析文件并生成多个提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式 rebase 合并提交。

say.text: 查一下 login 函数是谁写的。
say.note: Claude 会用 git blame 查找作者。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Git expert that helps you split code changes into multiple atomic commits, clean up commit history, and find who wrote a line or when something was added.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', or 'find the commit that'.

say_en.text: Help me commit these changes, split into multiple atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze files and generate multiple commits.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will perform an interactive rebase to squash.

say_en.text: Find who wrote the login function.
say_en.note: Claude will use git blame to find the author.
